report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Condromalacia rotuliana.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que no
impresiona contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales. Cartílago
troclear y de la rótula sin alteraciones.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Discreto aumento de señal de la aponeurosis continua prepatelar con discreto edema del tejido
celular subcutáneo adyacente.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales.
Discreto edema en relación a la aponeurosis continua prepatelar con edema del tejido celular
subcutáneo adyacente

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Sospecha banda iliotibial rodilla izquierda.
Hallazgos:
Médula ósea de intensidad de señal conservada.
Rotura del menisco medial, con componente horizontal longitudinal en cuerpo y cuerno posterior,
de predominio periférico, que presenta extensión a la superficie meniscal superior adyacente a la
raíz y pequeña extensión a la superficie articular inferior del cuerpo, periférica.
Menisco lateral de morfología y señal normales.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos, de aspecto habitual.
Cartílagos articulares de superficie regular. No identifico úlceras condrales.
Líquido articular discretamente aumentado en el receso suprarrotuliano, situado profundo a la
rótula. Escaso líquido en la vaina del poplíteo.
Edema focal entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral, que sugiere fenómenos de fricción
regional.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, de la pes anserina e isquiotibiales de aspecto habitual.
Estructuras musculares de señal conservada.
Impresión:
Rotura periférica del menisco medial, cuerpo y cuerno posterior.
Signos de fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.
Mínimo derrame articular

Findings: There is a moderate knee effusion. There is degenerate tearing of the body of medial meniscus which is seen to be extruded from the joint. Normal lateral meniscus.  
Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is complete loss of the medial compartment articular cartilage with underlying medial femoral and tibial condylar marrow edema. The lateral compartment articular cartilage is preserved. Minor subchondral bony change is noted in the lateral patellar facet. The patellofemoral articular cartilage is however well preserved.  
Conclusion: Severe medial compartment OA change with degenerate tearing and extrusion of the medial meniscal body.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Desgarro gemelo externo rodilla izquierda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Transformación quística parcial del LCA, sin signos de rotura. LCP y ligamento colateral lateral
dentro de límites normales.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del componente superficial del ligamento colateral
medial sin signos de rotura. El resto de los componentes sin alteraciones significativas.
Aumento de señal central periférico del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que impresiona
contactar la superficie articular inferior, puede representar una pequeña rotura, no desplazada.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras
condral de espesor parcial de la faceta medial de la rótula, sin cambios óseos secundarios. No hay
derrame articular y quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Edema de las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Transformación quística parcial del LCA, sin signos de rotura.
Cambios secuelares un esguince de bajo grado del aspecto proximal del componente superficial
del ligamento colateral medial.
Signos sugerentes de una rotura periférica del menisco medial. Correlacionar con clínica.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal.
Fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial

Regelrechte Artikulationsverhältnisse im linken Kniegelenk. Unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal. Patella zentriert stehend. Vorbekannter vollschichtige chondrale Läsion an der medialen Patellafacette (7/9) mit angrenzenden kortikalen Irregularitäten. Im Verlauf jedoch ohne wesentliche Progredienz. Darüber hinaus regelrechter Knorpelbelag femoropatellar. Auch femorotibial erhaltener Knorpelbelag ohne Chondropathie. Kreuzbänder intakt. Vorderes Kreuzband gering signalangehoben.
Innenmeniskushinterhorn mukoid T2 signalangehoben (5/9) ohne eindeutige Rissbildung. Etwas akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. V. a. Plica mediopatellaris (7/8). Kollateralbänder intakt. Neu zur Voruntersuchung ca. 2,9 x 1,2 x 2,1 cm messende Zyste lateralseitig oberhalb des LCL. Ansonsten umgebende Muskulatur und Weichteile unauffällig

Findings:  No evidence of knee effusion. There is undersurface tearing of the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral articular cartilage is preserved. Mild fraying and moderate thinning of the patellar ridge - medial patellar facet articular cartilage is noted with mild underlying bony change. The trochlear articular cartilage is preserved.  
Conclusion: Undersurface tearing of the medial meniscus. Medial patellar chondropathy.

МР находка: МР данни за ставен излив, като сред излива се намират зони със сигнална характеристика на разпадни продукти на хемоглобина, както при хемартроза. Вижда се изразен костномозъчен едем в кондилите на фемура и тибията, по-изразен от латералната страна. Не се открива фрактура на костите. МР данни за лезия на задния лог на медиалния менискус. Вижда се скъсване на задния рог на менискуса с формиране на свободен фрагмент. Визуализира се лезия и на задния рог на латералния менискус. В задния рог на латералния менискус се вижда хиперинтензна линеарна лезия с кос ход, която достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял на тибията – grade 3. Хиалинният хрущял на тибията и фемура е съхранен. Не се визуализират изменения в хрущяла на пателата. МР данни за частично скъсване на предната кръстна връзка. Предната кръстна връзка е с увеличен напречник и повишен сигнален интензитет. Нормално изобразяване на задната кръстна връзка. Вижда се частично скъсване на медиалния колатерален лигамент при залавното му към фемура място.  Латерален колатерален лигамент – без особености. Сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – б.о. Течност в поплитеалната ямка, както при Бекерова киста, най-вероятно руптурирала. Заключение: МР данни за фрагментиран  заден рог на медиален менискус. Лезия на заден рог на латерален менискус – grade 3.  Частично скъсване на предната кръстна връзка. Частично скъсване на медиалния колатерален лигамент. Хеморагичен ставен излив. Контузионен костно-мозъчен едем във фемумра и в тибията. Руптурирала Бекерова киста.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Chondropatie rétropatellaire légère à modérée impliquant l'apex et la facette médiale. Chondropatie légère à modérée touchant le condyle fémoral médial portant.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : Normal.

Ménisque médial : Normal.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normaux.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normaux.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-médial et postéro-latéral : Normaux.

Épanchement articulaire : Pas de liquide significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Aucun.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Léger oedème dans le paquet graisseux suprapatellaire.
Structure ovoïde hyperintense bien définie dans le récessus articulaire postérieur, craniale au LCP, mesurant 11 mm, compatible avec une souris articulaire cartilagineuse.

CONCLUSION :
Chondropatie rétropatellaire et du condyle fémoral médial légère à modérée.
Souris articulaire de 11 mm dans le récessus articulaire postérieur.
Signe d'un léger syndrome de conflit du paquet graisseux suprapatellaire.
Pas de déchirure méniscale ou ligamentaire.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs normaldir.   Lateral menisküs arka boynuzda radial inkomplet yırtık mevcuttur. Lateral menisküs gövde kesiminde ayrıca radial yırtık izlenmektedir. Lateral eklem aralığında kıkırdakta %50'den fazla kayıp izlenmekte olup grade III dejenerasyon lehine düşünüldü. Lateral eklem aralığında marjinal osteofitler izlenmektedir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Ön çapraz bağda diffüz hafif sinyal artışı izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar reseste minimal efüzyon mevcuttur. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Tibia eminensiada minimal subkondral ödem mevcuttur. SONUÇ: Lateral menisküste kompleks yırtıklar, eklemde efüzyon, lateral femoral ve tibial kondromalazi, ön çapraz bağda sinyal artışı.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Bilateral knee pain for months without known injury.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla extremity system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage heterogeneity at the lateral patellar facet

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: There is edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. There is lateral patellar tilt and translation. There is patella alta. Shallow trochlea and elongated lateral patellar facet. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION: Findings of active lateral patellar maltracking with mild patellar chondrosis.
